testcase.name: the WCAG relative luminance formula matches its reference values
essential text token pairs from globals.css reach WCAG AA 4.5:1
current text rules keep WCAG AA 4.5:1 on their declared backgrounds
essential controls keep a visible focus indicator
analysis tabs follow arrow, Home and End keys with wrap-around
citation deep links require both safe IDs and never treat partial links as document navigation
registered citation location rejects wrong registry identity, missing revision and unknown page
single and list references resolve each registered ID individually
an unknown ID inside a list stays non-validated while registered IDs stay clickable
cited IDs include list members so an unregistered reference is reported
malformed references remain plain text
HTML and Markdown markup stays literal text and is never turned into another part
components render no raw HTML sink or dynamic code
return between citations retains their respective extraction revisions and the explicit scope
ordinary navigation can return to an archived citation and retains its own unpinned state
native and globally routed unknown blocks do not become OCR overlays
whole OCR block uses its exact text and authoritative geometry
mixed block overlays only exact OCR spans with Unicode codepoint offsets
nested storage metadata is read but missing or inverted geometry is refused
an older opened version is validated against its own page count, not the active document count
an unknown version page count refuses the range instead of borrowing another count
inverted, zero and fractional ranges are refused
registered old citation pins a distinct blocks cache while ordinary navigation remains current
a registered citation without its extraction revision blocks substitution
pinned endpoint paths encode exact revision and preserve the unpinned routes
old raw provenance is accepted and a newer revision or mixed block revision is rejected
the outline must also belong to the registered citation revision
page and section actions remain enabled for current citations and require verified latest identity
an imported original and verified unpublished partial have no published extraction
a different active version does not publish the newly opened original
active and archived published generations are both consultable
non-BMP text returns codepoint offsets while retaining revision and exact hash
ligatures and combining accents preserve the exact source representation
whitespace map reconciles line breaks but does not invent a dehyphenation
cross-block selection resolves each immutable source and refuses ambiguity
selection is unavailable without an authoritative revision and source hash
selection offsets use raw_text when a presentation field differs
virtual page window never allocates more than five pages and stays in bounds
five canvases remain under the pixel cap at extreme zoom and DPR
a page-precision source draws no region box even when the API supplies bboxes
region sources draw only their own page geometry, in the opened version, without page-level blocks
blocks without geometry on the displayed page never borrow a box from another page
a declared region without valid geometry is shown as a page location, like its source card
labels share the source card vocabulary, including search hits without a top-level precision
legacy bboxes without blocks are drawn only for a single-page source
structured retrieval warnings display the actual message without passing an object to React
unknown warning fields are not displayed as arbitrary object content
readiness blockers are shown with readable labels and unknown codes stay visible
